chunks: He did not seek your support because of weakness,
nor did He demand a loan from you because of shortage.
He seeks your help, although He possesses the armies of the skies and the earth, and He is the Strong, the Wise,
the armies of the heavens and the earth
He is the Strong, the Wise
and He seeks a loan from you, although He owns the treasures of the skies and the earth, and He is the Rich, the Praiseworthy.
the treasures of the heavens and the earth
He is the Rich, the Praiseworthy
He only intended to test you as to which of you is best in deed.
He tests you as to which of you is best in deed
So be quick in your deeds so that you may be with the neighbours of Allah in His abode,
He accompanied them with His messengers, and visited them with His angels,
and He honoured their ears so that the sound of Hellfire may never reach them,
and He protected their bodies from weariness and fatigue.
That is the grace of Allah, He bestows it upon whomsoever He wills; and Allah is the Lord of Mighty Grace.

key_terms.اسْتَقْرِضَكُمْ: He demanded a loan from you

ai.seo_question: Why does Allah ask humans to worship if He is self-sufficient?
ai.summary: Imam Ali clarifies that the Divine command for worship is a pedagogical test of excellence (ihsan) rather than a need for sustenance, as Allah possesses the 'armies' and 'treasuries' of the heavens and earth. This passage underscores the Shia emphasis on voluntary devotion leading to spiritual proximity, where believers become 'neighbors of God' in the Hereafter, enjoying the company of prophets and angels while being shielded from the distress of Hellfire.
